name: Crescent Valley Merit Scholarship
criteria: Score 85% or above in the Crescent Valley Entry Test and 80% or above in intermediate.
coverage: 50% tuition waiver in the first semester, renewable each semester while CGPA stays 3.5 or above.
conditions: Full-time enrolment; CGPA 3.5+ to renew; cannot be combined with the Need-Based Grant or the Hafiz-e-Quran Concession.

name: Board Topper Award
criteria: Top 3 position in any Pakistani education board in matriculation or intermediate.
coverage: 100% tuition waiver for the first year, then 50% while CGPA stays 3.3 or above.
conditions: Board result certificate required; one award per student.

name: Sibling Discount
criteria: A sibling is currently enrolled at Crescent Valley University.
coverage: 10% tuition discount for the second sibling, 15% for a third.
conditions: Both students must be full-time; applies to tuition only, not hostel or admission fees.

name: Need-Based Financial Grant
criteria: Family monthly income below PKR 100,000, verified by documents; at least 60% marks in intermediate.
coverage: Up to 75% tuition waiver, decided case by case by the Financial Aid Committee.
conditions: Income documents and an interview; reviewed every year; cannot be combined with the Merit Scholarship.

name: Women in Engineering Grant
criteria: Female applicants to any Faculty of Engineering program with at least 70% in intermediate.
coverage: 25% tuition waiver for the full degree.
conditions: Must remain enrolled in an engineering program; CGPA 3.0+ to renew.

name: Hafiz-e-Quran Concession
criteria: Applicants who hold a certified Hafiz-e-Quran credential.
conditions: Certificate verified at admission; may be combined with the Sibling Discount but not the Merit Scholarship.
